rule: Each plan case of the group, in plan order, in two parts kept apart as the plan's SOURCE_AND_INSTALLED_MIGRATION evidence asks (`part`): the SOURCE cases are checked against source (S44 offline through the native qualification v3 reference model, the three MATRIX cases as source tests of W05's released build), and the INSTALLED case repeats the same contract rows on the enrolled hosts in W06. S44 lists one property per item of the plan's S44 case (W02D section 4.4's rejection list; 4.4's migration sentence is MATRIX:export/upgrade/rollback's, as the plan places it), and each S44 row serves the property its basis starts with. S44's subject is the native qualification v3 reference model the contract's vectors replay through, not a reader. A property is PASS only when every one of its vectors replayed and passed in this run, and NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE when its replay needs what the verifier profile lacks (owner decisions Q-T4 and Q-T20). The native v3 replay runs in TG-01's child process on the pinned met-001 venv python, and a missing or changed child interpreter fails the run instead of recording NOT_RUN (owner decisions Q-LC-1..4); S44 is PASS only when every property is. A case that waits for W05's release set or for W06's native hosts is NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE, never PASS (AGENTS rule 14), and its catalog names the contract vectors whose own expected results are its expected results (owner decision Q-T8).

catalog.basis: each reader refuses a record of another version with no fallback: every native v3 cross-version case (records and captures of v2 under v3 and of v3 under v2; native v3 carries 4.4's v1/v2 pair one version on, and the literal v1/v2 vectors are native v2's, not snapshotted)

each reader refuses a record of another version with no fallback: native v3 negatives refused as not a v3 record, or whose intent names an earlier version (a v1 schema version, a v1 cgroup path, a v2 fixture label)
a record missing EFFECT_GATE refuses: native v3 record negatives that delete the EFFECT_GATE role
a record with an extra role refuses: native v3 record negatives that add a role name the positive record lacks

a record with the gate under the BROKER key or path refuses: native v3 record negatives that set a gate or broker path field to the other role's value at the same field (the record half; captured data that shows the gate at the broker's paths is refused by the capture rules, and their aliasing refusals serve the alias property)

a record with an aliased role path refuses: native v3 negatives with the model's role-path aliasing refusals (one cgroup inode for two roles, one inode for two files, one file at two inodes), and record negatives that set a role's path field to another role's value (the gate and broker cases among them); a lifecycle subject placed at a role's cgroup path (R50) is the lifecycle property's, and a backend component there (native v3 R60) is in no TG-08 row

a record with a lifecycle subject inside a resident role cgroup refuses: native v3 negatives refused by the lifecycle subjects' cgroup path and placement schema, and capture negatives of a resident role whose own cgroup gains a lifecycle subject's process or whose inspected process runs in a lifecycle subject's domain (a resident role cgroup is a role's own cgroup: a process in the broker's delegated service cgroup, C20, is the delegated-subtree rule's)
a record with unknown backendComponents keys refuses: native v3 negatives refused by the backendComponents additionalProperties schema
